dct_description_sm: Our long-term goal is to evaluate the subtle behavioural effects of the low-to-moderate perinatal exposure to environmental contaminants, to dissociate the effects of each group of contaminants all along the children development, from 1 to 10 years of age, by using accurate innovative methods of behavioural assessments. The assessment of behavioural effects of environmental contaminants with our innovative methods involved 3 distinct steps: (a) collection of video recordings in the field, (b) behavioural analysis of these video recordings in the lab (behavioural coding), (c) statistical analysis of data obtained from behavioural coding.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Human health
Health sciences and contaminants -> Persistent organic pollutants (POPs)
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Inuit population
dct_title_s: Effects of perinatal exposure to environmental contaminants on activity, attention and emotionality in Inuit children: statistical analyses at 1 and 5 years of age and data collection of video recordings at 10 years of age
